near.method: Jaccard index over the set of function names in contractspecv0; single-linkage clusters; sets with fewer functions than the minimum are left out; names only, argument types not compared

sep41.method: all ten SEP-41 functions present with the SEP's input counts (names and arity only)

sep41Partial.method: seven to nine of the ten SEP-41 function names, or all ten with a different input count

sep41SacAdmin.method: SEP-41 plus set_admin, admin, set_authorized, authorized, mint, clawback
